findings.description: No widget tests present in codebase. Requirement states 'Widget tests cover key scenarios' but zero test files exist. The test/ directory is missing entirely.
findings.evidence: Search for *_test.dart returned no results. pubspec.yaml includes flutter_test but is unused. DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md confirms: 'Tests — None — no test files exist yet'
findings.impact: Cannot verify that UI components work correctly. Critical user flows (auth, dashboard, forms) are untested. Risk of runtime crashes and validation failures in production.
findings.fix: Create test/ directory with minimum 15 widget tests covering: (1) Login screen - form validation and submit, (2) Signup screen - all field validation, (3) Dashboard - loading/error/data states, (4) Fields list - empty and populated states, (5) Settings - theme and language toggles. Estimated effort: 4-6 hours.
findings.consequence: Blocks approval per requirement #12: 'Widget tests cover key scenarios'

findings.description: 10 hardcoded user-facing strings found across 5 files, violating requirement 'No hardcoded strings (all localized)'
findings.evidence: Examples: (1) 'Permission denied' at scan_screen.dart:38, (2) 'Error: ${e.toString()}' at scan_screen.dart:75, (3) 'Take or upload a photo...' at scan_screen.dart:138, (4) 'Soil test submitted successfully' at soil_test_form_screen.dart:92, (5) Text('English') and Text('हिन्दी') in dropdowns, (6) 'Hello! I'm your agricultural assistant...' at ai_chat_screen.dart:27
findings.impact: Hindi-speaking users will see English text mixed into UI. Breaks bilingual user experience. Some error messages and instructions only appear in English.
findings.fix: Replace all hardcoded strings with AppLocalizations keys: (1) Add scanInstructions, scanPermissionDenied, errorWithDetails keys to strings_en.dart and strings_hi.dart, (2) Replace Text('English') with localized language names, (3) Use l.aiWelcome instead of hardcoded welcome message. Estimated effort: 1-2 hours.
findings.consequence: Blocks approval per requirement #13: 'No hardcoded strings (all localized)'

findings.description: No build or runtime verification evidence provided. Cannot confirm app compiles or runs without crashes.
findings.evidence: No flutter analyze output, no build logs, no screenshots of running app. DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md requirement: 'App runs without crashes' but no evidence supplied. Flutter SDK not available on review machine to independently verify.
findings.impact: Unknown if code compiles cleanly. Unknown if app launches. Unknown if navigation works. Cannot verify requirement #15: 'App runs without crashes'.
findings.fix: Coder must provide: (1) Console output from 'flutter analyze' showing 0 errors, (2) Build logs from 'flutter build apk --debug' or 'flutter build ios', (3) Screenshots of app running on device/emulator showing all 5 main tabs, (4) Evidence of manual smoke test covering auth flow, dashboard, fields CRUD, scan, soil, AI chat. Estimated effort: 1 hour.
findings.consequence: Blocks approval per requirement #15: 'App runs without crashes' - unverified

findings.description: AI Assistant feature uses simulated responses instead of connecting to backend LLM service. Backend has complete LLM integration (per backend-completion-summary.md) but Flutter client does not call it.
findings.evidence: Code shows: Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 2), () { setState(() { _messages.add(ChatMessage(text: 'I understand your question...', isUser: false)); }); }); This is a hardcoded placeholder response. Backend has POST /v1/ai/chat endpoint with OpenAI/Anthropic integration but Flutter doesn't call it.
findings.impact: AI Assistant feature is non-functional. Users cannot get real agricultural advice. Feature appears complete but provides no value. Violates requirement #1: 'All 9 features are implemented and functional'.
findings.fix: Replace simulated response with actual API call: (1) Create AIRepository in features/ai/data/ calling POST /v1/ai/chat, (2) Create AINotifier in features/ai/application/ managing conversation state, (3) Update ai_chat_screen.dart to use provider instead of Future.delayed. Reference backend endpoint: backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/ai_assistant.py. Estimated effort: 2-3 hours.
findings.consequence: Blocks approval per requirement #1: 'All 9 features are implemented and functional'

findings.description: Splash screen missing. Required by Stage 1 of DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md but not implemented.
findings.evidence: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md Phase A item 2: 'Splash screen — Logo, tagline, auth-state check, then route to home or login.' Directory lib(frontend)/screens/splash_onboarding/ has only splash_onboarding_model.dart (FlutterFlow legacy). No production splash screen integrated into routing.
findings.impact: App launches directly to auth screen with no branding or loading state. Poor user experience. Auth state loading happens inline instead of on dedicated splash screen.
findings.fix: Implement splash screen: (1) Create splash_screen.dart in features/auth/presentation/, (2) Add splash route to app_router.dart as initialLocation, (3) Show logo and 'Khetopedia' text, (4) Check authStateProvider, (5) Navigate to /home if authenticated, /login if not, (6) Add 1-2 second minimum display time for branding. Estimated effort: 1 hour.
findings.consequence: Blocks approval per DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md Stage 1 requirement (splash screen is prerequisite for closing Stage 1)
